title: sdui_core v1.0 Payload
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for sdui_core v1.0 server-driven UI payloads. Backend teams can validate JSON against this schema before deploying to clients.

sdui_version.description: Schema version identifier. Must be "1.0" for this schema.

root.description: The root node of the UI tree.

type.description: Registered widget type string, e.g. "sdui:column" or "myapp:banner".

id.description: Stable, server-assigned identifier used for diffing. Must be unique across the entire tree. Prefer snake_case with no spaces.

version.description: Increment when this node's content changes. The renderer rebuilds only nodes whose version increases. Optional in v1.0.

props.description: Arbitrary key/value data forwarded to the widget builder.

actions.description: Named gesture handlers keyed by trigger name, e.g. "onTap".

children.description: Ordered list of child nodes. Only layout types (column, row, stack, etc.) render children.

action.description: Describes a side-effect triggered by a user gesture.

type.description: Built-in action types: "navigate", "dispatch", "show_snackbar", "open_url", "copy_to_clipboard", "show_bottom_sheet", "show_dialog", "dismiss_bottom_sheet", "refresh". Custom types route to registered Dart handlers.

event.description: Event name forwarded to the registered Dart action handler.

payload.description: Arbitrary key/value data passed to the action handler.

debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to debounce repeated triggers. Prevents double-tap issues on slow devices.
